title: Shoe Wash Bag – Protects Sneakers in the Machine
descriptionHtml:
Wash your shoes – without wrecking the machine

Washing shoes loose in the machine lets them slam hard against the drum. It wears out both the shoes and the washing machine.

Protects both shoes and machine

This wash bag has a protective inner material and a zipper that keeps the shoes in place. Both the shoes and the machine are spared while they get clean.

Features

  • Protective inner material
  • Zipper that keeps the shoes in place
  • Spares both shoes and machine
  • Fits most types of shoes
  • Reusable and durable

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
